note: PRODUCTION REPLACEMENT FOR GOOGLE SHEETS NODE - Use this in your n8n workflow. Replaces 'Append Lead to Google Sheet' node.
instructions: 1. Open your n8n workflow 'Agency Lead Finder'
2. Delete node 'Append Lead to Google Sheet' (sheets-append)
3. Add new nodes as defined in 'nodesToAdd' below, in order
4. Connect 'Filter & Tag Leads' -> 'Aggregate Leads for Bulk Ingest' -> 'POST to Leads API'
5. In 'POST to Leads API', set URL to your deployed server: https://YOUR_DOMAIN/api/leads/ingest
7. If you set LEADS_WEBHOOK_SECRET in server/.env, add header X-Webhook-Secret with same value
8. Save and Execute - check your web app at /leads for new boxes

nodesToAdd.name: POST to Leads API
nodesToAdd.notes: Set URL to your deployed server. Body is automatically {{$json}} which is { leads: [...] }. Add header X-Webhook-Secret if configured.
